newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal to tender for cell phone network next year.
newsitem.headline: Senegal to tender for cell phone network next year.

text.p: Senegal will launch an international tender next year for the setting up of a cellular telephone network for the West African country, an official at the government's telecommunications department said on Monday.
"An international tender will be advertised in 1997 for the selection of one or two operators for setting up a cellular telephone network," the source said.

Commercial operators will run the cellular network under plans announced by the government last May for the privatisation of telephone monopoly SONATEL, which has capital of 50 billion CFA francs and an annual turnover of more than 60 billion CFA.
